_doc: Inherited contrast debt that contrast-audit.mjs ratchets against. Every id here is a REAL
defect shipping today, listed so the gate can tell known debt from new debt -- not a list of
approved exceptions. Do not add to it to make a run go green.
overrideText  "<theme> | <selector> | <effective color> | <basis>" -- a hardcoded color in a
pilot's tokens.overrides.css that clears 4.5:1 on no surface it can land on.
basis: "page" = measured against bg AND bg-surface; "own <fill>" = the rule
declares its own background; "unresolved-*" = the pair could not be measured
(recorded rather than skipped, so that it cannot hide).
hoverState    "<theme> | <selector>" -- a :hover rule whose color is within deltaE2000 6 of
its resting color and that changes no other channel, i.e. the hover reads as no
change at all. Keyed without the two colors on purpose: they resolve through the
token layer, so a derivation tweak must not churn these ids.
LOWERING IT (the intended direction): fix the theme, run contrast-audit.mjs to see which ids
went stale, then `node docs/theme-surface/tools/contrast-audit.mjs --update-baseline` to prune
exactly those -- that mode refuses to add anything. Commit the pilot change and this file
together.
RAISING IT (rare, deliberate): only for debt that was ALREADY SHIPPING and that a scanner
improvement just made visible. `--update-baseline --accept-new` is the only path that writes
an addition; it prints every id it adds, and the diff is the review. A newly authored
low-contrast color is a design change, not a baseline entry -- pick a color that clears AA.
Seeded 2026-08-26 at 41 override + 11 hover entries: the exact debt the count-based ceilings
(OVERRIDE_TEXT_DEBT_MAX / STATE_DELTA_DEBT_MAX) carried before identities replaced them.
